<h1>Drum Cycler</h1>

## Purpose

Choose which drum destinations the TR-8's UP/DOWN buttons walk through.
There are six destinations: sequencers 13, 14 and 15, each in its normal
and its alt configuration: held in the eight-slot `drumcycler` array,
plus two slots reserved for a future drum sequencer. The view holds no
pattern and makes no sound; it only shapes the route UP/DOWN takes.

## Interaction

The **top row of the LP RHS**, one pad per slot, counting left to right
from column 1. The other 56 pads and the whole LP LHS stay dark.

| Slot | Pad | Destination | Lit colour |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | column 1 | TR-8, normal | green |
| 1 | column 2 | TR-8, alt | red |
| 2 | column 3 | seq 14, normal | yellow |
| 3 | column 4 | seq 14, alt | vivid orange |
| 4 | column 5 | seq 15, normal | blue |
| 5 | column 6 | seq 15, alt | violet |
| 6–7 | columns 7–8 | reserved | always dark |

A slot switched **off** shows dim grey rather than going fully dark, so
you can still see it is available. Both players see the same array: the
walk is a property of the rig, not of a player.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press a pad on the top row | LP RHS row 8 | Toggle that slot in or out of the walk (`0` ↔ its preset value) | none |
| Press a reserved pad | LP RHS row 8, cols 7–8 | Nothing. No destination is mapped there | none |

> Each slot holds a signed sequencer number: `13` is TR-8 normal, `-13` is
> TR-8 alt, `0` is out of the walk. UP/DOWN walks to the next **non-zero**
> slot, so switching one off removes it from the route rather than leaving
> a dead step.
